scope: Source-aligned matching view only; raw message text, raw ownership binding and learned preprocessing/export contracts are unchanged
controlMeaning: Arabic letter mark, left/right marks, directional embeddings/overrides/isolates and BOM are omitted from logical matching, not from the original source
projection: Do not attach a removed display control to the previous character. Controls inside a selected source span remain in its exact raw substring; prefixes/suffixes outside the selected token are not invented into the span.
emptyView: A message with no logical text is empty_or_malformed, not a scored financial candidate.
exclusions: This does not remove joiners or arbitrary zero-width characters, reorder letters, alter numbers or infer ownership.
